key_patterns: Routes: createFileRoute('/blog/$slug') pattern with loader + head + component. Data: typed TS files in src/data/ (blog.ts, catalog.ts, types.ts). UI primitives: shadcn-style wrappers in src/components/ui/ — Accordion, Breadcrumb, Card, Input, Button all exist and must be reused. Design tokens: use var(--primary), var(--u20x-navy), var(--u20x-blue), etc. — never hardcode colors. Layout: container-rhl + section-y utility classes. Newsletter subscribe: Footer already does this inline with sonner toast — the new NewsletterSubscribe component should follow the same form + toast pattern but with idle/loading/success/error state machine. Accordion: src/components/ui/accordion.tsx wraps @radix-ui/react-accordion — use it directly. Breadcrumbs: src/components/ui/breadcrumb.tsx has BreadcrumbList/Item/Link/Page/Separator — use it. Products: Product type and slugs are in src/data/catalog.ts + src/data/wholesale.ts; the article seed data references product slugs from that catalog (e.g. 'organic-beet-root', 'full-spectrum-cayenne', 'anthocyanin-bilberry'). date-fns is installed (^4.1.0).
directory_structure: src/routes/ — TanStack file routes; src/components/ui/ — shadcn primitive wrappers; src/components/site/ — Header + Footer (do NOT modify); src/components/blog/ — NEW blog components go here (directory does not exist yet, must be created); src/data/ — typed TS data files; src/styles.css — ALL design tokens and utility classes; src/assets/ — static images (capsules.jpg, cat-*.jpg etc.); public/ — favicons and SVGs.
